input.summary: Remove the per-transaction narrowing of the 12-month fee cap and add carve-outs for confidentiality breach, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need the mutual cap to be based on 12 months' fees rather than only the fees for the single related transaction, and we have added carve-outs so that confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct sit outside the cap alongside the existing Section 8 indemnity carve-out.
